name: Crab Game
desc:
💾 Round based GAMES. Sabotage others or win the whole thing.
This game is heavily reliant on sliding and building momentum. 
A recreation of Dani's "Crab Game" on steam. Go check it out!

CONTROLS:
📱 - Hold down slide button to slide, Double Tap screen to Hit.
🖥️ - Hold down C or CTRL to slide, M1 to hit.
🎮 -  L1/L2/L3 to slide, R2 to hit.
